Dreaming of traveling the world?
In partnership with Visit Dubai, we’re launching the Beautiful Destinations Academy—the world’s first elite training experience designed to build the next generation of travel content creators.
We’re offering four emerging creators an all-expenses-covered, paid opportunity to learn directly from our elite content team. You’ll master cinematic techniques, AI, brand strategy, and the business of tourism in a 12-week program that will define your career - and give you unparalleled access to one of the most exciting cities in the world.
• Applicants must be over 18
